description: in the 403 license_expired response to anchor (heartbeat spec 9.5): the vendor checked this anchor (9.2 steps 1-4), stored it as a gap witness and does not countersign it. The appliance treats the 403 as a license lock only if the statement is effective, appliance_id is its own, chain_id/tree_size/merkle_root are exactly those of the anchor this request sent and server_ts is within 15 minutes of its clock. Not a countersignature: never chained as CHECKPOINT_RECEIPT

server_key_id.description: a key of role statements (format spec 10.7.3); until ende_doppelbetrieb the wrapper of licence statement, refusal and activation receipt and pages of kind v1 carry a countersigning key (format spec 10.7.5); key_id grammar of format spec 10.7.1

server_signature.description: Ed25519 over the UTF-8 bytes of statement_jcs

statement_jcs.description: the statement in JCS form (RFC 8785); only these UTF-8 bytes are signed; at most 2048 characters unless the kind names its own statement_jcs_maxlen (anchor_history_v2: 131072)

title: Signed vendor statement: anchor_refusal
